sandbox: macOS sandbox-exec: no network, home folder unreadable, one scratch folder writable

tools.name: create_serializer
tools.description: Creates a new serializer instance with the given secret key and optional salt. secret_key: The secret key to sign and verify with. Can be a list of keys, oldest to newest, to support key rotation. salt: Extra key to combine with secret_key to distinguish signatures in different contexts. Example: create_serializer('my-secret-key', 'session-context') -> Serializer instance.

tools.name: serialize_and_sign
tools.description:
Serialize an object and sign it with the provided secret key. secret_key: The secret key used for signing, obj: The object to serialize and sign, salt: A salt value to use when signing. Example: serialize_and_sign('secret', {'key': 'value'}) -> 'eyJrZXkiOiAidmFsdWUifQ.XYz123...'"
    
    Args:
        secret_key: The secret key used for signing the serialized data
        obj: The object to serialize and sign
        salt: A salt value to use when signing
        
    Returns:
        A signed string serialized with the internal serializer
        
    Raises:
        ValueError: If the serialization fails

tools.name: deserialize_without_verification
tools.description: Deserializes a signed string without verifying the signature. secret_key: The secret key used for signing and verification, signed_string: The signed string to deserialize without verification, salt: Salt to use for the serializer. Returns a dictionary with 'signature_valid' (bool) and 'payload' (str or None).

tools.name: create_timed_serializer
tools.description: Create a timed serializer for signing and verifying data with expiration. secret_key: The secret key used for signing and verifying signatures. salt: A salt value to use for the signer. serializer: The serializer to wrap; defaults to JSONSerializer. Returns a dictionary with the serializer's representation.

tools.name: create_signer
tools.description:
Creates a new signer instance with the given secret key and optional salt.
    
    Args:
        secret_key (str | list[str]): The secret key to sign and verify with. Can be a 
                                     list of keys, oldest to newest, to support key rotation.
        salt (str, optional): Extra key to combine with secret_key to distinguish 
                             signatures in different contexts.
    
    Returns:
        str: String representation of the signer instance.
        
    Example:
        >>> create_signer("my-secret-key", "context-salt")
        "<itsdangerous.Signer object at 0x...>"

tools.name: sign_data
tools.description: Signs the given string. secret_key: The secret key used for signing, e.g. 'my_secret_key' -> 'hello.world.signature'. value: The string or bytes value to sign, e.g. 'hello.world'.

tools.name: verify_signature_only
tools.description: Verifies the signature for the given value. value: the value to verify the signature for, signature: the signature to verify against the value, secret_key: the secret key used for signing. Example: verify_signature_only('hello', 'sig', 'key') -> True.

tools.name: base64_encode_url_safe
tools.description: Base64 encode a string of bytes or text. The resulting bytes are safe to use in URLs. string: The string or bytes to encode using URL-safe base64 encoding, e.g. 'hello' -> 'aGVsbG8'.
